topology_transfer.frame: Identical fixture, bearing bore, exactly identical frame shell and unit loads. Prior frame solves reused at both mesh spacings.
topology_transfer.yoke: Both meshes solved again with the native current CAD and the current production mass model to preserve exact bearing loads.

scope: Small-strain homogeneous polymer with the yoke underside and frame shaft bores fixed. Pressure is spread over nominal contact faces or both pin ears. Bearing reactions apply peak elastic force to the rigid head at zero rebound speed. The coupled yoke sensitivity applies additional unit radial reactions at the seats. Layer adhesion, imperfect first-edge contact, bearing clearance and collapse require separate evidence.

equivalent_mass_measurement.physical_load_scope: Full numerical equality of the old and new load reports after excluding the input mass-file digest. The only measured change is in the stationary base cup.

fused_mass_transfer.retained_fem_mesh_unit_traction_uncertai: Original native finite-element compliances retained. The stop force scaling and loaded bearing reactions were recomputed with the revised measured mass. Maximum change in the nominal yoke bearing-force vector is below 0.002 N per 1 N applied at the stop.
